paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 4.28 as of September 29, with a change of 0.47% from the prior close and a change of -13.88% over a window of 21 sessions. There has been one new news item in the last 24 hours.

Fermi Inc. has recently been in the news with an article from Hart Energy on September 29, stating that NAES will operate and maintain natural gas generation planned for Fermi's 17-GW Texas data center campus. This news is part of the company's Project Matador Gas Fleet.

There have been various SEC filings from Fermi Inc., including forms PX14A6G, 3, 8-K, and 4, with the most recent ones dated September 11, September 3, August 31, August 27, and August 18. The filings include insider transaction reports and a notice of the company's first annual meeting of stockholders.
